title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One week before Tsukasa's birthday
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! The bath's ready. Do you want to get in fi—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahaha, you really want to go first that badly? Okay then, just let me know when you're out♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Will do...
No, wait. That's not why I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aw, the envelope is decorated with a bunch of bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... “To my dearest beloved sister, Saki Tenma”... “You are invited to attend the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival”?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? You're not hosting your own birthday party, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am indeed! But it is more than just a mere birthday celebration...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This party will be dedicated to those who have continued to support me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh! But, why this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not long ago, I was researching shows when I happened upon an article about an actor's birthday event.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The actor said, “Birthdays shouldn't serve to celebrate the day you were born, but rather to thank others for the life you have led,” and I couldn't agree more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see! And so you decided to do the same!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! I've fine-tuned the festival program to ensure that all guests have the experience of a lifetime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! I can't wait to see what you've got in store for us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, so does that mean you've finished preparing for it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I've got my hands full right now trying to make all the invites as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My birthday is only a week away. I have to hand these out before everyone's schedules fill up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'll help you make them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? I must say, I'm grateful for the offer, but you do realize that you're one of my special guests, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pretty pleeease? Making them looks fun, and at this rate, I'll be the only one there to enjoy your amazing party that you worked so hard to put together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come ooon...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fine, okay. I'll give in and accept your gracious offer!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, who else are you making the invites for? Is there anything else I can help with? Tell me, tell me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, now, calm down, Saki. Let's start with the guest list...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Saki, have you and Tsukasa decided who's going to take a bath first?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right, we almost forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's pick up where we left off once we're both done. We're going to put on the best party ever, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go, go, go!
Tsukasa's birthday

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Boy, I'm really looking forward to Tsukasa's birthday party♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, although I didn't expect him to suddenly thrust an invitation into my hands...and such a cute one at that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I heard, Saki also had a hand in the preparations, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I recall, Tsukasa's house is just around this corner... Ah, there it is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Wait, do you guys see that sign in front of the house?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see it! It says... “This way to the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival”♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, a sign that colorful stands right out. We definitely know that we're in the right place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did he have to make it that flamboyant?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe☆
I'm already super hyped, so let's hurry up and go inside!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, Nene, Rui! Welcome to the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please wait here for a moment♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Everyone's here already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I expected you would all be invited too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we received Saki and Tsukasa's handmade invitations.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They had quite the design...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At first, I didn't know that Saki had helped, and I was surprised that Tsukasa had decorated them like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, you're saying that you were amazed Tsukasa decorated them so beautifully?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, of course not...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were so surprised because it was so unexpected.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I don't see Aoyagi. Has he still not arrived?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About that... Toya tried to keep today free for this, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He said that the date of an event he was signed up for got moved forward to today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... That's a shame. He sounded like he was really looking forward to it when I spoke to him in class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but he stopped by this morning! He even gave Tsukasa a gift from the rest of his team!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, I promised to take a good video of Tsukasa shining at the party so he can watch it later♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hurray! That's bound to put a smile on Toya's face.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? The lights went out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that the festival is about to begin.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you for coming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Where's his voice coming from?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Look, at the top of the stairs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ladies and gentlemen! The Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival is about to commence!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This event is dedicated to all of you, who have shown me nothing but love and support!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There will even be a special show, so please enjoy every moment until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! We get to see a special show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even I don't know what the show's about. I can't wait to find out♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with that, let the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival begin!
